title: Ali ke baba ka
body:
Ali ali ali ali ali ali..(2)
ali ke baba ka..(10)
<<DIVIDER>>
Kya bataaoon aapko, kya kya abu talib ka hai
rabb e kaaba ki qasam, kaaba ab utalib ka hai
<<DIVIDER>>
haaan....
dekhta hoon jab alam, aati hai ye dil se sadaa
<<DIVIDER>>
parcham e abbas par panjaa abu talib ka hai
abu talib abu talib..(4)
<<DIVIDER>>
Sab par hai ehsaan ali ke baba ka
deen e nabi hai daan ali ke baba ka
<<DIVIDER>>
1) Jiska namak haqq mehr mey aaya zehra ke
jispe pale hai paalne waale dunya ke
<<DIVIDER>>
hai wo dastarkhaan ali ke baba ka ..(2)
Sab par hai ehsaan....
<<DIVIDER>>
2) Nau zilhajj ko choomne jaatii hai dunya
chakkar uske ghar ki lagaatii hai dunya
<<DIVIDER>>
hai ye pataa aasaan ali ke baba ka ..(2)
Sab par hai ehsaan....
<<DIVIDER>>
3) Farsh e zamee'n par kaar e khudaayii kartaa kaun
aqd e khadeeja aur Mohammad padtaa kaun
<<DIVIDER>>
ye bhii hai ehsaan ali ke baba ka ..(2)
Sab par hai ehsaan....
<<DIVIDER>>
4) Jaise huwa tha arsh pe aqd e zehra me
tera(13) rajab waise hi sehne Kaaba me
<<DIVIDER>>
jashn ho aaliishaan ali ke baba ka ..(2)
Sab par hai ehsaan....
<<DIVIDER>>
5) Uski zabaa se pehle lafz nikalte hai
phir jaakar alhamd ki aayat bante hai
<<DIVIDER>>
qaarii hai qur'aan ali ke baba ka ..(2)
Sab par hai ehsaan....
<<DIVIDER>>
6) Jaao Jaao
Jaao jahannum tum sab ki aisii taisii
<<DIVIDER>>
manwaalega tumse aakar khud MEHDI(ajtf)
matt maano ehsaan ali ke baba ka ..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
Sab par hai ehsaan....
7) Jannat se malboos kahaa woh laaya tha
<<DIVIDER>>
eidiii lekar Dada kii wo aaya tha
naukar tha rizwaan ali ke baba ka ..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
Sab par hai ehsaan....
8) Iska banaane waala takallum shia tha
<<DIVIDER>>
nikle yahaa se jo hai dushman shiyo ka
hai ye pakistaan ali ke baba ka ..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
Sab par hai ehsaan ali ke baba ka
deen e nabi hai daan ali ke baba ka
author: Mir Hassan Mir
